name: Alpe d'Huez
blurb: Twenty-one numbered hairpins from Le Bourg-d’Oisans to the ski station.

name: Mont Ventoux from Bédoin
blurb: Forest switchbacks, then the bare white moonscape to the summit tower.

name: Col du Tourmalet from Luz
blurb: The west side through Barèges to the highest paved pass of the central Pyrenees.

name: Col du Galibier from Valloire
blurb: Open high valley, then steep ramps above Plan Lachat to 2,642 m.

name: Passo dello Stelvio from Prato
blurb: Forty-eight hairpins up the north ramp to 2,757 m.

name: Passo Pordoi from Arabba
blurb: Steady switchbacks beneath the Sella towers.

name: Grossglockner from Heiligenblut
blurb: The alpine road from the village church to the Hochtor tunnel.

name: Sa Calobra
blurb: The famous snake of a road from the cove up to Coll dels Reis.
